events.title: EGYPTIKA Chants & Dance
events.description: An Egyptian mystery school ceremony and ecstatic dance evening led by EGYPTIKA — a practitioner working within ancient Egyptian sacred traditions. The evening unfolds through Vocal Flow Activation, Ankh Breath, Postures of Power & Dance, and Egyptian Chants, honouring Hathor: the Egyptian goddess of love, music, dance, and beauty. Held in the intimate cinema space of Paradiso Ubud, the format weaves ancient ceremonial breathwork, embodied movement, and devotional chanting into a single continuous arc — from activation into surrender. Doors open at 17:45 for an 18:00 start. 200,000 IDR presale via Megatix; 250,000 IDR at the door.
